claim_boundary.allowed: turns the measured sample-hold and decision-budget results into a concrete comparator fixture contract
claim_boundary.not_allowed: does not simulate comparator transistors, prove comparator noise, prove SAR conversion, prove extracted layout, or replace converter economics

next_implementation_steps: start with a clocked differential latch or preamp-latch deck in Sky130 ngspice
drive it from the existing differential dummy sample-and-hold candidate instead of an ideal voltage source only
measure offset first, because a noisy comparator with unknown static offset cannot be interpreted
measure kickback before SAR integration, because kickback spends the same voltage budget as hold error
add repeated-noise or corner-style sweeps only after the nominal transient deck is numerically stable
keep the output as candidate schematic evidence; do not write accepted post-layout evidence

required_measurements.acceptance: absolute offset <= 0.1530 mV target and below 0.1567 mV hard budget
required_measurements.method: sweep a small differential input around zero and find the sign-change point
required_measurements.name: input_referred_static_offset_mv

required_measurements.acceptance: combine with static offset by root-sum-square before comparing with the budget
required_measurements.method: run repeated transient decisions with the same input and measure output-code spread as input-referred voltage
required_measurements.name: decision_noise_rms_mv

required_measurements.acceptance: sample-hold movement plus input-referred decision uncertainty remains below 2.197265625e-04 V
required_measurements.method: measure differential held-node movement when the comparator input is connected and clocked
required_measurements.name: kickback_on_held_decision_node_v

required_measurements.acceptance: resolves inside the SAR comparison time used by the converter estimate
required_measurements.method: measure how long the latch output takes to reach a valid logic level near the smallest accepted input
required_measurements.name: metastability_resolution_ns

required_measurements.acceptance: record the value, but do not use it for break-even until the full extracted converter payload exists
required_measurements.method: integrate supply current during one comparison event
required_measurements.name: supply_energy_per_decision_j

stimulus_cases.input: small signed differential inputs around zero
stimulus_cases.name: zero_crossing_offset_sweep
stimulus_cases.purpose: find whether the comparator decision boundary is shifted away from zero

stimulus_cases.input: differential input at 0.1530 mV plus the measured sample-hold error
stimulus_cases.name: budget_edge_pass_case
stimulus_cases.purpose: check the strongest already-passing budget point

stimulus_cases.input: differential input at 0.1581 mV plus the measured sample-hold error
stimulus_cases.name: budget_edge_fail_guard
stimulus_cases.purpose: prove the fixture can detect when the known budget is exceeded

stimulus_cases.input: reuse the low, mid, and high common-mode cases from the candidate input sweep
stimulus_cases.name: low_mid_high_sampled_inputs
stimulus_cases.purpose: make sure comparator loading does not destroy the sample-and-hold result that already passed

stimulus_cases.input: reuse the matched and +/-1% and +/-2% sample-switch width cases
stimulus_cases.name: controlled_width_mismatch_cases
stimulus_cases.purpose: keep the current mismatch regression gate alive after the comparator is attached
